other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage during cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent constructs target-encoded features (e.g., aggregations of the target variable by categories) using the entire training dataset before splitting it into cross-validation folds. This leaks the validation set targets into the training features during cross-validation, leading to artificially inflated validation scores and suboptimal model/ensemble tuning.

summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated solution with robust domain-specific feature engineering, proper test-set isolation for imputations, and an optimized out-of-fold blending ensemble. However, the solution contains a critical target leakage flaw: neighborhood-level target aggregations (like median sale price) are calculated on the entire training set before cross-validation, leaking validation targets into the training folds and artificially inflating cross-validation performance.
